_comment: Eastern Cape Department of Education Grade 11 Mathematics P2 (statistics, analytical geometry, trigonometry, measurement and Euclidean geometry), November 2024 provincial common examination.
Questions and marking-guideline answers transcribed from the rendered pages of the official PDFs
(paper2.pdf, paper2_memo.pdf); the text layer does not hold usable equations. Notation:
^ for powers, sqrt() for roots, a/b for fractions, decimal commas as printed. memo_answer is the
guideline's final answer and memo_working its working (tick marks and mark descriptors left out).
The guideline is bilingual (English/Afrikaans); only the English is transcribed. Graphs and diagrams are described
in brackets in the question text. The information sheet printed with the paper is not transcribed.
FORMAT: 150 marks, 3 hours, ten compulsory questions (Q1 10, Q2 11, Q3 10, Q4 20, Q5 30, Q6 12, Q7 7,
Q8 10, Q9 15, Q10 25). Candidates answer in a 25-page SPECIAL ANSWER BOOK (number line for 1.5, table for
2.1, grids for 2.4 and 6.4); the answer book was not part of the downloaded files and is not tracked.
Q3: the question text gives R(2 ; 3) but the diagram labels R(3 ; 4); the guideline marks both versions,
